description: Land Acquisition - Kadirana North, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Kodigaha, Nuwaraeliya D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1951/9 of 25.01.2016 by Kolonna D/S Division, - Correction Notices for the notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1118/6 of 07.02.2000 and 1120/17 by Mawanella D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters, specifically notices under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific land parcels to be acquired by the government for public purposes, provides detailed descriptions of the properties (including location, extent, and features), and outlines procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
